text: The Malaysian government banned Kean Wong's Rebirth: Reformasi, Resistance and Hope in New Malaysia on 1 July 2020 under the Printing Presses and Publications (Control of Undesirable Publications) Order 2020. The ban related to the book's cover, which was alleged to resemble the national coat of arms. At the time, the book was also the subject of an investigation into whether its cover had allegedly insulted the Malaysian federal coat of arms.
meta_description: Rebirth by Kean Wong was banned in Malaysia on 1 July 2020 over a cover alleged to resemble the national coat of arms.
